note: Chosen by scripts/evaluate_variants.py on the held-out set per the plan's smaller-configuration rule: 1.7B FP32 missed the p95 4 s provisional-lag target on CPU (about 140 ms per token, 15.25 GiB peak), 1.7B int4 was rejected (+2.0 pp Mandarin CER), 0.6B FP32 was accepted (no category worse than the 1.7B baseline, no new silence failures) and meets the target. The 1.7B FP32 proof is archived under reports/proof-1.7b and reports/current-1.7b; the 2026-09-07 late-night resume audit (separate Codex session, DirectML probe on the RX 9060 XT, self-test) is summarized in docs/RESUME-AUDIT.md.
